changelog:
- Initial release of design-md-generator.
- Generates structured DESIGN.md files from any website URL.
- Extracts complete visual design tokens: colors, typography, spacing, components, shadows.
- Follows the Google Stitch DESIGN.md format with 9 standard sections, covering everything from visual theme to agent-ready prompts.
- Supports automated CSS token extraction and screenshot capture for detailed documentation.
- Optionally produces preview HTML catalogs for quick visual reference.
